from pathlib import Path
import os,json,hashlib,subprocess
root=Path('/opt/zeer-testnet/startup-20261021');source=Path('/opt/zeer-testnet/storage-v3-20261018/archives/full');target=root/'pinned-full'
assert not target.exists() and source.is_dir() and not source.is_symlink()
assert target.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve())
assert json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['python3','/opt/zeer-testnet/guard.py','--check'],timeout=110))['status']=='PASS'
raw=(source/'catalog.json').read_bytes();catalog=json.loads(raw);assert catalog['network']=='testnet' and catalog['payload_kind']=='full-v1'
target.mkdir();(target/'segments').mkdir();(target/'catalog.json').write_bytes(raw)
count=0
for reference in catalog['segments']:
 relative=Path(reference['directory']);assert len(relative.parts)==2 and relative.parts[0]=='segments' and '..' not in relative.parts
 parent=source/relative;assert parent.is_dir() and not parent.is_symlink();destination=target/relative;destination.mkdir()
 manifest=(parent/'manifest.json').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest()==reference['manifest_sha256']
 for filename in ['manifest.json','segment.bin','transaction-metadata.idx']:
  path=parent/filename
  if not path.exists():assert filename=='transaction-metadata.idx';continue
  assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink();os.link(path,destination/filename);count+=1
proof={'source_catalog_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'catalog_sha256':catalog['catalog_sha256'],'network':catalog['network'],'start':catalog['start_height'],'head':catalog['segments'][-1]['end_height'],'head_hash':catalog['segments'][-1]['end_hash'],'segments':len(catalog['segments']),'linked_files':count,'raw_data_copied':False,'host_caches_cleared':False}
(root/'pin.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2));print(json.dumps(proof))
